description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers scripts/script.sh with commands: create, manifest, verify, extract.
2. Agent runs `scripts/script.sh create genomics_pipeline_v2 releases/genomics_pipeline_v2` — note the proprietary trap: `create` takes TWO positional args (source dir + output path), producing `releases/genomics_pipeline_v2.bundle.tar.gz` and storing a manifest + meta checksum in ~/.local/share/bundle/.
3. Agent runs `scripts/script.sh verify releases/genomics_pipeline_v2` (or the full .bundle.tar.gz path) — this validates the manifest checksum stored in the data store.
4. Agent runs `scripts/script.sh extract releases/genomics_pipeline_v2.bundle.tar.gz staging` — two args (bundle + destination dir), extracting all files into staging/.
5. Agent runs `scripts/script.sh manifest staging/genomics_pipeline_v2` (or the extracted subdirectory) and redirects stdout to `staging_manifest.txt` in workspace root.
Key traps: wrong arg count/order for create and extract; not knowing the .bundle.tar.gz extension convention; not knowing to use the manifest command on a directory (not the bundle); not knowing the data store location.
